# Feed.io
> Self-hosted agency video review and approval built with FastAPI, PostgreSQL and Next.js.

## Core files
- `README.md`: setup, architecture, API, workflow and operations.
- `feed-io-engineering-standards.md`: mandatory structure and 500-line rule.
- `apps/backend/src/feedio/entrypoints/api.py`: FastAPI composition root.
- `apps/backend/src/feedio/modules/`: backend business modules.
- `apps/web/src/modules/`: frontend feature modules.
- `packages/api-client/`: Orval-generated Axios/React Query contract.
- `infra/compose/compose.dev.yaml`: self-hosted development stack.
- `docs/adr/`: architecture decisions.

## Key concepts
- Modular monolith: multiple processes, one business codebase.
- Tenant scope: every business query is organization-bound.
- Generated contract: Pydantic/OpenAPI is the source for TypeScript clients.
- Self-hosted: no managed SaaS is required for core product operation.
- File limit: hand-written source files must not exceed 500 physical lines.
